### Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc. Announces Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release Date and Conference Call


October 19, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s206.q4cdn.com/352443609/files/doc_news/Sabra-Health-Care-REIT-Inc--Announces-Third-Quarter-2026-Earnings-Release-Date-and-Conference-Call-2026.pdf)


TUSTIN, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc. (Nasdaq: SBRA) announced today that it will issue its 2026 third quarter earnings release on November 2, 2026, after the close of trading.


A conference call with a simultaneous webcast to discuss the 2026 third quarter results will be held on Tuesday, November 3rd at 10:00 a.m. Pacific Time. The dial-in number for U.S. participants is 833-461-5787. For participants outside the U.S., the dial-in number is 585-542-9983. The conference ID number is 325673757.


The webcast URL is[https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/325673757](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fnam12.safelinks.protection.outlook.com%2F%3Furl%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.google.com%252Furl%253Fq%253Dhttps%25253A%25252F%25252Fevents.q4inc.com%25252Fattendee%25252F325673757%2526sa%253DD%2526source%253Dcalendar%2526usd%253D2%2526usg%253DAOvVaw3iB_6QtKybbZKIju8MeTLO%26data%3D05%257C02%257Csmazur%2540sabrahealth.com%257Caeb07f0fb0b54bae4f2708df2b0501ad%257C71ffff7c7e534daaa503f7b94631bd53%257C0%257C0%257C639276972774509235%257CUnknown%257CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%253D%253D%257C0%257C%257C%257C%26sdata%3DKY8CadTD%252FhPNwlWKuil6vegLLrC1KJ9qWWDkshjy2Pw%253D%26reserved%3D0&esheet=54623692&newsitemid=20261019603264&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F325673757&index=1&md5=bff099d28f63e48df765681138f0302c) . A digital replay of the call will be available on our website at[www.sabrahealth.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.sabrahealth.com&esheet=54623692&newsitemid=20261019603264&lan=en-US&anchor=www.sabrahealth.com&index=2&md5=ba417b419d3d358a2a62954e89ca2a02) .


**About Sabra**


Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc., a Maryland corporation, operates as a self-administered, self-managed real estate investment trust (a "REIT") that, through its subsidiaries, owns and invests in real estate serving the healthcare industry throughout the United States and Canada.
